# Vue testing best practices by Anthony Fu — Vue 3.5 skill

Curated by Skill Harbor — Anthony Fu's official Vue skill (17,400+ installs, the most-installed new skill in our mega-sweep): a complete Vue 3.5 reference generated from the official Vue.js documentation. Covers the Composition API with `<script setup lang="ts">` (defineProps, defineEmits, defineModel, defineExpose, generics), the reactivity system (ref vs shallowRef, computed, watch/watchEffect, effectScope, composables), lifecycle hooks, built-in components (Transition, Teleport, Suspense, KeepAlive, v-memo), custom directives, and testing best practices. Ships with detailed reference files (script-setup-macros, core-new-apis, advanced-patterns) plus a quick-reference component template and key-imports cheat sheet. Strong opinions baked in: TypeScript over JavaScript, Composition API over Options API, shallowRef when deep reactivity isn't needed. Honest caveats: guidance for the agent, not a test runner — you still need Vitest/Vue Test Utils in your project; generated from vuejs/docs, so verify against the Vue version you target. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
